Turn heads in the statement St Tropez One Sleeve Dress designed to accentuate every curve with elegance and confidence. Crafted from a silky, stretch fabric, it drapes smoothly across the body while offering a comfortable, contouring fit.

Onyx — A rich, timeless black that sculpts and defines with effortless elegance

The bodice features a twist-front detail with bold, sculpting cut-outs that highlight the waist and décolletage. A unique asymmetric shoulder wrap adds drama and balance to the silhouette.

The skirt flows into a sleek maxi length with a high thigh-split, giving you effortless movement and a touch of sensuality with every step.

Perfect for birthdays, evening events, red carpets, or nights you want to own the room.

Detail:

  • Luxe stretch finish and body hugging
  • Twist-front bodice with sculpting cut-outs
  • Asymmetric shoulder design
  • High leg split for a striking silhouette
  • Maxi length
  • Hidden bodysuit for a perfect fit
  • Model is 5"7 wearing size S
  • Short and tall girl friendly and best worn with heels

  • XXS if you are super petite
  • XS if you are slim petite
